answer: Builder's pick: canary-variant prompts. The beacon seed deals each ID a private variant of the task with one planted detail, a lantern only that ID was shown (say, an invented port number). If ID A's answer echoes the detail planted for ID B, or two answers mirror each other's canaries, both are linked as one operator sharing context and split one payout for 48 epochs. Proposed: 1 canary per ID per epoch, 2 hits to link; false-link rate is unmeasured, test on honest pools first.
